login.title: Senel Patna Login
login.welcome: Welkam bek! Sain insait long menesim ol 'lead' bilong yu.
login.heroTitle: Groim 'real-estate' bisnis bilong yu wantaim olgeta 'lead' yu bringim
login.heroIntro: Wanpela portal bilong rejistaim ol kastoma wantaim ol bilda, holim kredit bilong ol 'lead' bilong yu na bihainim ol i go inap long taim yu bukim.

register.title: Rejistretim ol 'lead' insait long sampela seken tasol
register.text: Salim kastoma bilong yu na projek we ol i laikim.

protect.title: Dupliket proteksen
protect.text: Lid bilong yu i stap bilong yu long taim bilong lukautim, olsem na i no gat narapela man i ken kisim wankain kastoma.

track.title: Trakim olgeta step
track.text: Lukim 'status' bilong wanwan 'lead' na ful histori, stat long namba wan kontek i go inap long taim yu bukim.

handover.title: Kredit taim yu bukim
handover.text: Taim wanpela kastoma i bukim, ol i save givim 'lead' i go long 'builder' na yu rekodim olsem 'source partner'.

login.secure: Gutpela sain-in - ol ditel bilong ol kastoma bilong yu i stap praivet

signup.title: Rejistresen bilong ol patna bilong senel
signup.intro: Wokim akaun bilong yu long stat long rejista na menesim ol 'lead' bilong yu yet.
